items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: we went on the road with a show with the Mills Brothers... We had Ralph Brown who was a very good dancer in those days.

ctx.x: -- you see? Because he believed in playing music that people could dance to, and you'd always see the people just skim around the floor beautifully, you know, and relaxed because it was that type of band, that type of music.

So we come out of Connie's Inn and the next year, like 1933, we went on the road with a show with the Mills Brothers, one of the most fantastic shows, to me, road shows that has been ever put together. We had Ralph Brown who was a very good dancer in those days.
